chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام would give the adhan while someone else would perform the iqamah, and he would also perform the iqamah when someone else had already given the adhan.

key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the subject of the report
key_terms.يُؤَذِّنُ: gives the adhan, the call to prayer
key_terms.يُقِيمُ: performs the iqamah, the call commencing the prayer

ai.seo_question: Can one person give the adhan while another person performs the iqamah?
ai.summary: This report describes the practice of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding the adhan and iqamah. It indicates the permissibility of one person giving the adhan and another performing the iqamah, and also that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام himself would at times perform either one of them.
